notablePrerequisites: At least six charge counters on Everflowing Chalice.
description:
Activate Everflowing Chalince by tapping it, adding at least {6}.
Activate Galvanic Key by paying {3} and tapping it.
When you activate Galvanic Key, Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy that ability.
Resolve one copy of the Galvanic Key ability, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat.
